responsibility: This header declares the default target hook functions implemented in targhooks.cc. It is the public prototype catalog for the generic backend behaviors that can be referenced from target hook initializers or overridden by ports, covering calling conventions, RTL/address handling, builtins, vectorization, OpenACC/OpenMP support, output and section selection, address spaces, library capability checks, speculation safety, memtagging, gcov type sizing, and numerous other target hook entry points.
same_name_distinction: Acts as the declaration catalog for default target hook functions, whereas gcc/targhooks.cc contains the actual generic backend implementations those prototypes describe.
